bugs_found: transfer() does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/string inputs can cause TypeError during comparison or arithmetic despite other functions accepting numeric-like inputs
compound_interest() silently truncates fractional years via int(years), producing incorrect results for non-integer durations
months and compounds_per_year are silently truncated with int(), accepting invalid fractional values instead of rejecting them
financial results are not rounded/quantized to currency precision, which can leak excessive Decimal precision into balances/payments
